blockers.description: Reopen evidence: `docs/operations/restore-drill-report.md` recorded a restore drill that never ran, with teams and backup systems this single-operator Supabase + Railway deployment does not have. It was replaced with an honest "no drill yet" report.
Reopen evidence: `infra/monitoring/oncall-schedule.json` defined multi-team weekly rotations. There is no rota. It was replaced with the real escalation path (the owner, via the alert channel).
Reopen evidence: "Alert rules configured": `infra/monitoring/alerts-config.yaml` is not loaded anywhere connected to production (see IFC-032).

To close: (1) Run a real restore drill (a Supabase backup restored into a scratch project), with a timed log as evidence. (2) Keep the on-call file to the real escalation path, and prove the alert channel (IFC-032). (3) SLO alerts loaded in the hosted backend and proven by a received test alert. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.
